data.description:
Sporting Event on Hardie St Both Directions in Guilford County from Ontario St to Ellington St. All lanes closed. Id: 12614
Comments: The City of Greensboro will host the GO FAR 1 Mile Fun Run and 5K on Saturday, November 14, 2026. Street closures associated with the event will begin at approximately 7:45 AM and remain in effect until approximately 10:30 AM. The following roadways will be affected by closures or intermittent traffic holds during the event: • Ellington St (between W Gate City Blvd and Coliseum Blvd) • Hardie St (between Ellington St and W Meadowview Rd) • Ontario St (near Hardie St and Crestridge Rd) • Crestridge Rd • Murrayhill Rd • Urban Dr • Old Chapman Rd • Emerywood Rd • Portions of W Meadowview Rd at designated runner crossings Motorists should expect delays, limited access in the area surrounding the Greensboro Coliseum Complex, and intermittent traffic holds as runners move along the course. Drivers are advised to use alternate routes and follow directions from law enforcement officers and all posted traffic control devices.
data.comment:
The City of Greensboro will host the GO FAR 1 Mile Fun Run and 5K on Saturday, November 14, 2026. Street closures associated with the event will begin at approximately 7:45 AM and remain in effect until approximately 10:30 AM. The following roadways will be affected by closures or intermittent traffic holds during the event:
• Ellington St (between W Gate City Blvd and Coliseum Blvd)
• Hardie St (between Ellington St and W Meadowview Rd)
• Ontario St (near Hardie St and Crestridge Rd)
• Crestridge Rd
• Murrayhill Rd
• Urban Dr
• Old Chapman Rd
• Emerywood Rd
• Portions of W Meadowview Rd at designated runner crossings 
Motorists should expect delays, limited access in the area surrounding the Greensboro Coliseum Complex, and intermittent traffic holds as runners move along the course. Drivers are advised to use alternate routes and follow directions from law enforcement officers and all posted traffic control devices.
